The decisions playground is now served at `/ml-inference/playground` instead of `/ml-inference/decisions`. I haven't run the build, the tests or the app.

I changed the route path in two places:
- `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx`: the route key and the `urls.decisionPlayground()` helper.
- `frontend/src/products.tsx`: the same two lines. This file is generated from the manifest by `pnpm build:products`, so I made the matching edit by hand rather than regenerating it. A regeneration should produce the same result.

Everything else that links to the page, including the Storybook story, goes through `urls.decisionPlayground()`, so it picks up the new address without further edits. A search found no other frontend references to the old path. The scene, its logic and the page content are unchanged.

I left the backend API path `/api/projects/:id/ml_inference/decisions/decide/` alone. It's an API endpoint rather than a page address.

I didn't add a redirect from the old address, so `/ml-inference/decisions` will now show a 404 for anyone with it bookmarked. Say if you want one.
